name: a11y-consultancy
description: Personal single-page site offering front-end accessibility consultancy services.

scripts.test:html: npm run build && html-validate dist/index.html dist/privacy.html dist/accessibility-statement.html
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:3000 pa11y-ci
scripts.test:keyboard: npm run build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:3000 "node test/keyboard-nav.test.cjs"
scripts.test:lighthouse: npm run build && start-server-and-test start http://localhost:3000 "node scripts/run-lighthouse.cjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:contrast && npm run test:html && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:keyboard && npm run test:lighthouse
